Meet The Cousins
Jim Tselikis & Sabin Lomac
Founders & Cousins

Cousins Jim Tselikis and Sabin Lomac founded Cousins Maine Lobster on a simple idea: real Maine lobster should not require a trip to Maine. Their online shop now ships live Maine lobster and the roll kits, tails, soups, and family meals they are known for to homes across the country.

From Maine, With Love

It started with family. In Maine, lobster is not saved for special occasions. It is what brings everyone to the table. Jim and Sabin built Cousins Maine Lobster to bring that table to the rest of the country: live lobsters, roll kits, tails, and soups, packed with care and shipped from Maine to your door.
